examples.description: 15-second high-resolution social reel: script (Gemini Flash) + Runway render with 1.5× resolution premium, 2 render retries expected, 8% transcoding overhead on video generation.

lines.notes: Billable GPU-seconds; qty multiplied by resolutionPremium (video only)

optimal_engine_by_objective.min_cost_short_reel: runway_video @ 1s_render + gemini_flash_text — lowest $/s for iterative drafts
optimal_engine_by_objective.max_quality_motion: runway_video_4k @ higher costPerUnit or raise resolutionPremium > 1.5
optimal_engine_by_objective.fastest_iteration: gemini_flash_text only for copy A/B before locking render; defer Runway until script approved

examples.description: 60-second animated-style motion clip with ElevenLabs voiceover (~1.2k chars) and Gemini Flash narration/script (~2k tokens). Two parallel render lanes (e.g. picture-in-picture + main), 10% transcode ladder, one retry pass on fragile video+TTS.

optimal_engine_by_objective.lower_tts_cost: shorter VO script or cheaper TTS tier (lower costPerUnit in calibration)
optimal_engine_by_objective.reduce_video_cost: shorter motion segments + cross-fade stills (leonardo_image) instead of full 60s generative video

examples.description: Multi-variation A/B pack: 10 copy/image variants (Gemini + Leonardo) while sharing one 12s master video render. Five parallel workers add coordination overhead; one retry on fragile providers; 8% transcode on shared video.

lines.notes: Single hero clip reused across variants — not multiplied by 10

optimal_engine_by_objective.maximize_ctr_testing: gemini_flash_text + leonardo_image for 10-way copy/visual A/B; keep runway_video single shared asset to avoid 10× video cost
optimal_engine_by_objective.minimize_credit_spend: reduce leonardo_image outputs or use static template backgrounds; shorten shared runway_video seconds
optimal_engine_by_objective.faster_wall_clock: parallel.jobs=5 lowers elapsed time; credits include coordination overhead — tune coordinationOverheadPerExtraJob from observability
